scope: Editable Figma redesign and proposed interaction contract for odd-context-picker; no runtime implementation or library publication.

decisions.defaultPresentation: Anchored non-modal dialog, 416 × 480 reference size, containing a search textbox and separate result listbox.
decisions.expandedPresentation: Explicit modal browser for deep hierarchies; mobile full-screen dialog at <480px of usable viewport width or insufficient overlay space.
decisions.selection: Single or multiple; multiple requires no modifier keys; sourceId + id is the stable identity.
decisions.ownership: Host owns committed value, resources, providers, asynchronous search and external selected-context display.
decisions.dismissal: Immediate retains accepted changes. Confirm discards draft on Cancel/Escape/Close/outside dismissal. Expansion preserves mode, scope, location, query and draft.
decisions.hierarchy: Container navigation and selectable folder references are distinct; references do not silently include descendants.
decisions.searchSemantics: Only supplied connected sources are searched; per-source failures remain distinct from successful zero-result searches.
rejected: Interactive navigation or remove buttons inside listbox options

proposedApiMapping.design: Row checks, count, Selected view and external host chips. Identity is sourceId + id. Keep selected snapshots when pages or search change.
Single replaces the previous value and closes on accepted immediate selection. Multiple toggles independently, stays open, and never requires Ctrl/Command.
Immediate emits each proposed change. Confirm creates a draft and shows Cancel / Add N. Expansion retains the same mode and draft.
Source labels and IDs; search, browse, recent, favorites and selectable-container capabilities. Hide affordances that the host does not provide.
Request ID, loaded records, per-source status and optional cursor/total. A response is applied only to its matching request. Loading/error are outcomes, not independent API flags.
At the limit, prevent adding unselected records and explain why. Keep selected records removable. A host reducing the limit never silently drops existing values.
Disable the trigger and editing; continue showing existing host context. Localize all labels, errors, counts and announcements. Read-only is an external display composition.

proposedApiMapping.input: query, location, active row, draft, open
proposedApiMapping.design: Query changes never clear selection. Active focus is independent of selection. Dismissal rules are determined by commitMode; no public hover/focus/empty/error booleans.
Keep default semantics intact. Host actions may request upload or reconnection; they do not implement transport or authentication. External chips/rows are owned by the consumer.

research.name: VS Code / Copilot
research.application: Observed pattern: an explicit Add Context entry and typed references for files, folders, symbols and other resources. Transfer: multiple discovery paths and visible attachments. Do not transfer coding-only names into the default picker.

research.name: Cursor
research.application: Observed pattern: typed @ references with matching suggestions across files, folders, chats and browser context. Transfer: low-friction search and explicit scope. Reject required mention syntax and automatic whole-folder assumptions for this domain-agnostic component.

research.name: Cloudscape
research.application: Observed guidance: match the entry method to the source and confirm provided context. Transfer: source identity and acknowledged selection. Keep multi-step authentication or upload in host integrations, outside core selection responsibilities.

research.name: ARIA listbox and combobox
research.application: Listbox options do not support nested interactive controls. This design uses a search textbox plus a separate listbox in a dialog; it does not force multiple selected resources into a single-value combobox.

research.name: ARIA dialog, menu and tree
research.application: Modal dialog focus containment is used only for the expanded/mobile browser. A resource value picker is not an action menu. Native drill-down navigation is simpler here than introducing tree semantics and independent child actions.

research.name: Current implementation and Figma
research.application: Inspected checkout e44c4fe4: packages/ai/src/context-picker/*.ts and Figma 124:86 / 124:99. The live URL could not be read by the research tool. Claims about current behavior are based on the inspected source and editable library specimen, not live usability testing.

directlyObserved: Inspected source renders an attached-item list, status/inspect/remove actions, Add files and optional Add link.
Inspected source has no query, provider navigation, transient selection surface or confirm-mode draft.
Existing editable Figma Ready context specimen is 636 × 120.
The live Oddkin page was inaccessible through the web research tool; current-behavior observations come from the checkout and Figma.
hypothesesNotUserTested: An anchored default may reduce task interruption.
Explicit provenance and searched scope may reduce selection mistakes.
Persistent cross-query selection may improve predictability.

verification.editability: Native Figma text, vectors, components, instances, slots and auto-layout frames; no image-filled nodes.

sampledContrast.scope: Sampled semantic role pairs only; not a rendered UI or accessibility conformance audit.

verification.componentSetOverlapAudit: No overlapping or out-of-bounds variants in the inspected component sets.
notVerified: Real browser keyboard or screen-reader behavior of the proposed implementation
